purpose: Prospectively redesign only the sampling-sensitive query count and strict maximum-energy ordering identified by V73. Test whether increasing from sixteen to thirty-two truth queries makes the unchanged physical and morphology core attainable, and replace the exchangeable coin-flip energy ordering with a one-sided truth-oracle-calibrated no-detectable-inferiority rule. Do not train, sample a model, relax a physical threshold, access fresh data, or reinterpret V72.

authorization.user_instruction: The user explicitly instructed '다음 단계 진행' after receiving the V73 result and recommendation for a V74 prospective gate redesign.

population.source: the immutable V73 fit-train summary after excluding all forty-eight V70 mechanism-holdout objects

TNG100.16: four queries from every x-z quadrant
TNG100.32: eight queries from every x-z quadrant

Swift.16: select sixteen of twenty realisations without replacement and draw one query from each
Swift.32: draw one query from all twenty realisations, select twelve realisations without replacement, and draw one additional distinct query from each selected realisation

truth_oracle.selection: draw with replacement from the query's frozen group after excluding every query index in that trial
truth_oracle.second_energy_oracle: draw an independent oracle B by the identical law
truth_oracle.coarse_oracle_limit: This is a group-conditional empirical-population oracle, not an exact repeated draw at identical target-free conditioning.

uses: estimate unchanged-gate pass probabilities for comparison
select the lowest query count whose unchanged sampling core is attainable
verify the calibrated energy family-wise false-rejection rate

independent_monte_carlo_phases.independence_limit: The seeds are independent Monte Carlo draws from one fixed empirical population; this tests resampling stability, not independent-box generalization.

unchanged_sampling_sensitive_core.q99_999: absolute pooled oracle-minus-query log10rho q99.999 difference <=0.1 dex
unchanged_sampling_sensitive_core.Q4: pooled oracle-over-query mean delta-squared ratio in [2/3,1.5]
unchanged_sampling_sensitive_core.high_k_power: mean oracle-over-query log-density power in [0.9,1.1] in both 3-6 and 6-10.0531 h/Mpc bands
unchanged_sampling_sensitive_core.residual_RMS: oracle-own centered truth-minus-deterministic residual RMS over query-own residual RMS in [0.9,1.1]
unchanged_sampling_sensitive_core.density_PDF: oracle-query histogram TV is strictly lower than deterministic-query histogram TV
unchanged_sampling_sensitive_core.two_point: oracle-query KS is strictly lower than deterministic-query KS in every frozen 0-1, 1-3, and 3-10 Mpc/h scale mean
unchanged_sampling_sensitive_core.environment: every frozen oracle mean peak/void statistic has strictly smaller absolute error than the deterministic query mean
unchanged_sampling_sensitive_core.joint: all absolute and morphology checks pass

query_count_decision.probability_interval: two-sided 95-percent Wilson interval over the 20000 verification trials
attainable_if: the Wilson lower bound of the aligned all-three-domain joint pass probability is at least 0.8
the Wilson lower bound of every single-domain absolute-core pass probability is at least 0.8
query_count_decision.selection: choose the lowest candidate query count satisfying every attainability condition
query_count_decision.if_neither_count_is_attainable: do not relax a threshold; classify that an additional metric-level redesign is required
query_count_decision.V73_reproduction_check: the sixteen-query verification all-domain joint point estimate and each domain absolute/joint point estimate must be within 0.02 absolute of V73

energy_redesign.old_rule: candidate mean per-query maximum-energy score must be strictly lower than the independent control in every domain
energy_redesign.old_rule_null_behavior: exchangeable oracle A beats oracle B with probability one half and is therefore not an attainable all-domain validity gate
energy_redesign.statistic: mean over queries of oracle-A unbiased scalar maximum-energy score minus oracle-B score
energy_redesign.multiplicity_reason: one-sided alpha 0.05 divided by three domains; each domain-and-query-count upper margin is the linear 59/60 quantile of its calibration null
energy_redesign.prospective_rule: candidate-minus-control mean maximum-energy score must not exceed the frozen domain-and-query-count oracle upper margin
energy_redesign.interpretation: no detectable inferiority at family-wise alpha approximately 0.05; superiority is separately reported and is not required
energy_redesign.verification: report per-domain and aligned all-domain false-rejection probabilities and Wilson intervals; energy redesign is calibrated only if the all-domain point false-rejection probability is <=0.06 and its Wilson upper 95-percent bound is <=0.065
energy_redesign.consumed_V72_diagnostic: apply only the selected sixteen-query frozen margin to the already recorded V72 candidate-minus-control mean deltas as a diagnostic; never change V72

excluded_components.rank_histogram_and_voxel_coverage: V73 established that the coarse cross-query donor construction is not a valid exact conditional null for aligned-voxel calibration; these require a separate audit before a complete prospective gate can be frozen
excluded_components.exact_DC: deterministic numerical invariant, not a sampling problem
excluded_components.cross_domain_common_law: already measured by V73 and not rerun
excluded_components.TNG_spatial_heterogeneity: already measured by V73 and not rerun

predeclared_outcomes.query_count_redesign_sufficient: one candidate query count satisfies every Wilson-lower attainability rule and the V73 sixteen-query reproduction check passes
predeclared_outcomes.additional_metric_redesign_required: neither query count satisfies the attainability rule
predeclared_outcomes.energy_redesign_calibrated: the frozen oracle-margin verification meets both family-wise false-rejection limits
predeclared_outcomes.reason_full_gate_remains_incomplete: rank histogram and voxel coverage still lack a defensible exact-conditional null audit

resource_and_firewall.new_candidate_or_fresh_gate_after_result: forbidden without a separately frozen complete gate and explicit user approval
